source.name: Tennis.com - PIF becomes first naming-rights partner of WTA rankings
source.note: Multiyear partnership announced 20 May 2024: PIF is the first naming-rights partner of the WTA rankings. PIF's own page at bnpparibasopen.com/partners/pif describes it as 'Global Partner of the WTA Tour' and 'exclusive naming partner of both the ATP and WTA Rankings'; wtatennis.com/rankings still brands the list 'PIF WTA Rankings' as of 25 Sep 2026.

note: Rankings naming partner (PIF WTA Rankings) and tour Global Partner.
